auth_type.correction: bearer (short-lived JWT). Exchange username+PAT (or password) via POST /v2/auth/token; legacy POST /v2/users/login is deprecated. OpenAPI security scheme is HTTP bearer JWT—not a static apiKey.

rate_limits.correction: Image pulls (registry): unauthenticated 100/6h per IPv4 or IPv6 /64; Personal (auth) 200/6h; Pro/Team/Business unlimited (fair use). Hub HTTP API: separate global per-minute limits via X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset (not per-endpoint quotas); plus a separate abuse limit (~thousands req/min, all plans).

example.correction: Documented tags path is GET /v2/namespaces/{namespace}/repositories/{repository}/tags (e.g. https://hub.docker.com/v2/namespaces/library/repositories/nginx/tags?page_size=5). Old /v2/repositories/{ns}/{repo}/tags still works but is not in current OpenAPI. Bearer value must be a JWT from POST /v2/auth/token (PAT is the login secret, not the Bearer token). Public tags also work unauthenticated.

notes: API is live. Canonical docs: docs.docker.com/reference/api/hub/latest/ (old docker-hub/api/latest URL 301s). OpenAPI server is https://hub.docker.com with /v2 paths. Main failures: auth classified as apiKey; rate_limits invents per-endpoint Hub API quotas; example uses undocumented path and implies PAT-as-Bearer.
